title: EventCheif
tagline: Know what's happening in the blockchain community and get RSVP'd for the events
description: It helps in the seamless organization of an event for the organizer and an easy and fast RSVP staking process for the users who are interested in the event. Organizers on the frontend side get the option to create a new event with all the relevant information, while the interested population have the option to reserve their spots in some specific event by staking some amount in terms of cryptocurrency, which they get back immediately when they confirm their presence in the event.
how_its_made: We are beginners in the web3 space and this is one of our early projects, and in this limited amount of time we had to scour the internet for tutorials and relevant resources for pretty basic build.
